per_company.name: EOTECH
per_company.evidence_note: EOTECH originated as an L-3/L3Harris business and was sold on 31 July 2020 to American Holoptics, a Koucar Management affiliate; the acquisition consideration was paid to L3Harris and was not primary EOTECH financing. For EOTECH LLC's acquisition of Intevac's Photonics business, closed 30 December 2021, transaction adviser Houlihan Lokey explicitly states that its Capital Markets team acted as EOTECH's exclusive placement agent and arranged, structured and negotiated financing. The financing amount, instrument and capital providers were not disclosed, so one amount-undisclosed issuer financing event is retained without invented investors. The seller disclosed up to USD 100 million acquisition consideration, including USD 70 million upfront and up to USD 30 million earn-out; that purchase price is not the financing amount.
per_company.hold_note: The 2020 American Holoptics acquisition used subordinated debt with warrants at the buyer holding company, not at EOTECH, and is excluded from EOTECH's financing history. The 2021 acquisition financing is confirmed but its lender/investor identities, instrument and amount remain undisclosed. Seneca's 2024 exit is an ownership transfer with no issuer proceeds established.
